name: openreflex
description: Muscle memory for AI coding agents: learns from every task, advises the next one, and flags failure loops live.

interface.shortDescription: Local execution memory and path advice for coding, investigation and reasoning.
interface.longDescription: Captures substantial coding, investigation and reasoning work through lifecycle hooks, reuses relevant past experience, tracks execution cost, flags loops and stagnation, and learns from confirmed outcomes. Core memory stays local.
interface.defaultPrompt: What has OpenReflex learned about this project?
